facts.text: Made From Effort is the website and Journal of Performance Edge Training + Gym Design.
Scott Schratwieser is the founder of Performance Edge Training + Gym Design.
The business is based on Long Island, New York.
Scott holds the CSCS credential.
Scott started training clients in 2010.
Scott spent nearly a decade at Equinox, including time as a Master Instructor.
Residential gym design includes private homes and estates on Long Island and select projects elsewhere.
Residential gym planning considers training zones, clearances, circulation, sightlines, storage, and the relationship between fitness and recovery spaces.
Equipment plans are based on the client's training, available space, aesthetic, and long-term use.
Gym design coordination can involve the client's architect, interior designer, builder, AV team, and other project partners.
Residential service scope includes equipment sourcing, vendor coordination, lead-time planning, delivery sequencing, and specification oversight.
Physical construction is handled by appropriately licensed project partners.
The business accepts select yacht and marine gym projects.
The business accepts select commercial gym, boutique studio, and country-club fitness projects.
One-on-one personal training is available on Long Island, New York.
Online and virtual coaching includes individual programming, video form review, practical nutrition coaching, behavior-change work, and check-ins.
Remote coaching does not promise a live video session at every workout.
Coaching is a separate service from gym design.
The completed Jupiter Island Estate gym project is in South Florida.
Glen Cove is documented as a mid-project render study, rather than a completed installation.
Performance Edge accepts select hotel and hospitality gym-planning inquiries; its service page does not claim a completed hotel fitness case study.
